svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: A table of fourteen rows: what the bridge declares, how many of it there are, and where each number is read from. The plugin publishes 133 float4 parameters across twenty-four domains, and pushes each one to nine ENB stage shaders. The C++ name table and the shader header declare the same 133 names, and the two sets are identical. Engine reflection registers fourteen record types carrying 827 named fields, of which the weather record alone holds 487. There are twenty-one re-runnable validation harnesses in the tests directory, nine of which need an external mod corpus and are skipped without one. The command channel accepts nineteen verbs through a shared memory block of 5,184 bytes. The Papyrus surface registers forty-one script functions, and the plugin ABI is at version one. Four CTest targets are declared. No in-game acceptance result is recorded anywhere in the tree, so nothing here is evidence about how a frame looks on screen.

g.text: published parameters

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 133 float4s
The C++ name table in BridgeData.cpp and the shader header
both declare 133, and the two name sets match exactly. Neither
file can see the other, so a one-sided edit is a red test.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: parameter domains

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 24 of them
Celestial through theme, each with its own header comment and
its own count. The comment count and the declarations under it
are compared, so a drifted header fails rather than misleads.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: target shaders

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: nine of them
Sun sprite, effect prepass, effect, effect postpass, lens,
underwater, depth of field, bloom and adaptation. Every
changed parameter is written once per shader.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: record schemas

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: fourteen
Image space, volumetric, lighting template, weather, climate,
region, light, water, effect shader, image space modifier,
worldspace, grass, land texture and tree.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: named fields

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 827 in all
Counted by walking the field macros and literals in each schema
and multiplying through the loops that generate them, rather
than by trusting the table in the specification.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: weather record

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 487 fields
Seventeen colour types across four times of day, thirty-two
cloud layers with colour and alpha per time of day, a directional
ambient cube, fog distances and the raw data bytes.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: validation harnesses

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 21 in tests
Each one is a standalone script with its own exit code, and the
runner refuses to start when its inventory of corpus tests names
a file that is no longer there.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: corpus harnesses

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: nine of them
Codec and mesh harnesses that need an external mod corpus.
Portable mode skips them and runs the other twelve, so a fresh
checkout still has something to prove.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: command verbs

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: nineteen
Ping, reflection, texture, model, region, game status, travel,
script report and cell report. Anything else is refused rather than
guessed at.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: command mailbox

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 5,184 bytes
A shared memory block with the verb at offset 32, the
arguments at 64 and 576, and the result text at 1088. A harness
pins every offset against the C++ static assertions.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: papyrus functions

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: 41 declared
Registered on the papyrus surface so a script can read
published state by name, looked up against the same table the
render path pushes from.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: bridge abi version

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: one
kBridgeInterfaceVersion in the public header. A consumer that
compiled against a different number is meant to refuse the
interface rather than reinterpret it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: ctest targets

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: four declared
An inline comment parser, the portable harness run, and two
that check this card and this artwork. The last two run under
plain Python with no compiler and no graphics device.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: in-game acceptance

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: none in the tree
The validation protocol states that every one of the six gated
features ships off, and that live acceptance is a separate manual
procedure nothing here carries out.

svg.text: Every count here was read from the header, the table, the harness or the CMake script that declares it rather than typed in, and
tools/check_repo_facts.py reads those same files. The marked row is the honest null: this repository proves that the offline math, codecs and protocol
layout hold, and it proves nothing about live rendering.
